title: release.yml bump_type has no default (HTTP 422); links.yml --cache is never persisted and its report artifact is never uploaded; prettier || true hides errors
Link checker relies on --max-retries, which cannot cover a connection reset during connect: a healthy URL fails the run
`all_recovered` is computed from the re-asked subset alone, so a report holding one 404 and one connection reset ends the run green
links.yml: .lycheeignore is missing from the paths filter, so adding an ignore entry does not re-run the link check
check-web-archive.mjs reports all_archived=true when lychee's only errors are non-HTTP links
